byteward.sentence: Thrushwell is recalling its Pulse 3 smartwatch, the company announced today.
It says the watch's battery can swell and push the screen out of the case.
About 410,000 watches are covered by the recall.
Thrushwell is telling owners to stop using the watch right away.
Owners who return the watch will get a full refund.

ohm-and-bit.sentence: The Pulse 3's problem is a battery that can swell until it pushes the screen out.
Thrushwell traced the faulty cells to a single supplier.
In those cells, the separator, the thin film that keeps the electrodes apart, was thinner than specified.
Only watches made between March and June 2025 are affected.
That still adds up to about 410,000 watches.
Thrushwell is also pushing a software update that puts a recall alert on affected watches.

bench-and-bill.sentence: The Consumer Device Safety Office today posted Thrushwell's recall of its Pulse 3 smartwatch.
According to the notice, the office has received 37 reports of batteries swelling.
The recall covers only watches made between March and June 2025.
They were sold from April 2025 through October 2026.
Owners are entitled to a full refund.

launch-desk.sentence: Thrushwell says the battery lasts up to four days on a charge.
